_comment: Public bootstrap only. cadenceHours 0 lets the first private runtime cycles collect evidence without encoding a person's routine in the repository. The scheduler-owned daily private review maintains the live file from observed yield, attention, battery cost, latency, provider use, and notification urgency. Mechanics in evogent-cycle.sh only read the values.
